issues.description: Constructor mismatch for PersonController: the solution repository implements PersonController with a constructor that requires a String baseUrl parameter, but both the template and solution H05E01ClientApplication (and the problem statement expectation) instantiate PersonController with the no-argument constructor (new PersonController()). This is a structural inconsistency in the solution: as-is the application code will not compile/run because there is no matching no-arg constructor. Students will be confused about which constructor to implement and whether the controller should accept a base URL parameter.
issues.suggested_fix: Restore consistency by providing a no-argument constructor for PersonController (for example: public PersonController() { this("http://localhost:8080/"); }) so existing instantiation (new PersonController()) remains valid. Alternatively, update H05E01ClientApplication to call the parameterized constructor (new PersonController("http://localhost:8080/")) everywhere. The recommended fix is to add the no-arg constructor to PersonController to preserve backward compatibility with the template and the exercise instructions.
